abstract: In this paper, we first prove Appleton's conjecuture on the uniqueness of noncollapsed steady solitons constructed in \cite{Appleton}. We also classify non-Ricci-flat $\kappa$-noncollapsed cohomogeneity one steady gradient Ricci solitons in dimension four and five. After passing to a finite cover, in dimension four, they must be the Bryant soliton or Appleton's noncollapsed 4d steady soliton; in dimension five, they must be the Bryant soliton or solitons constructed by Ivey--Dancer--Wang.
hook: Steady Ricci solitons with cohomogeneity one symmetry in dimensions four and five are classified
summary: Steady Ricci solitons are shapes that stay fixed under Ricci flow. The authors prove Appleton's conjecture that his noncollapsed four-dimensional solitons are unique, then show that noncollapsed, non-Ricci-flat solitons with this symmetry in dimensions four and five are the Bryant soliton or known examples. The classification applies only to highly symmetric cases in these two dimensions.
title: Classification of cohomogeneity one steady gradient Ricci solitons in dimension four and five
